scope: VLM scale and architecture generalization of Full-path RSM-AttnRes followed by token-level native ReSkip only after a quality gate

method.name: Residual-Strength Modulated AttnRes (RSM-AttnRes)
method.new_component: one zero-initialized scalar projection per target AttnRes block
method.primary_role: token-conditioned calibration of the ordinary Full AttnRes residual correction
method.training_objective: assistant-token CE + 1.0 * Full-path teacher KL - 0.02 * native routing entropy

shared_training_recipe.steps_policy: 3000 for Qwen3-VL; 5000 for SmolVLM2 and InternVL3.5 to match the pre-existing cross-decoder adaptation protocol
shared_training_recipe.learning_rate_policy: 0.001 for Qwen3-VL; 0.0002 for SmolVLM2 and InternVL3.5, fixed from archived pre-existing transfer evidence before observing RSM quality
shared_training_recipe.gamma_schedule: linear 0 to 1 over first 30% of steps, then fixed at 1; gamma excluded from optimizer
shared_training_recipe.adapter_rank_policy: hidden_size/8 rounded to the established model recipe
shared_training_recipe.teacher: fresh frozen copy of the same pretrained VLM

formal_evaluation.primary_metric: unweighted macro-average of official lmms-eval task scores
formal_evaluation.qwen_seed_policy: report each seed and mean plus sample standard deviation
formal_evaluation.cross_family_policy: report each architecture separately; do not pool incomparable raw task metrics

quality_gates.full_rsm_continuation_rule: continue to ReSkip calibration only when Full RSM is non-inferior to the matched Full AttnRes control within 0.30 percentage points and remains above Base
quality_gates.reskip_accuracy_rule: macro-average loss relative to Full RSM no greater than 0.30 percentage points
quality_gates.runtime_rule: matched device-side benchmark throughput must exceed Base; host-selector wall time is not accepted as a speed result

gpu_policy.exclusion_reason: GPU 7 was occupied by an unrelated user process at freeze time

training_data.name: project-local v3 mixed adaptation stream
training_data.sampling: the established data_v2 v3 weighted stream with a recorded per-run seed

evaluation_data.name: local lmms-eval caches for AI2D, MMBench, MMMU, MMStar, OCRBench, RealWorldQA

software.evaluation_framework: the project-pinned lmms-eval installation in the same environment
